items.title: Airbnb Shares Jump Over 10% as Third-Quarter Earnings Beat Forecasts and Travel Bookings Accelerate
items.summary: Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) reported stronger-than-expected third-quarter financial results, supported by accelerating travel demand, higher booking volumes and improved pricing. The accommodation platform delivered its fastest revenue growth in more than three years and raised its full-year outlook, sending its shares more than 10% higher in premarket trading on Friday.
